task.title: Add a failure_streak counter and quarantined status to the task schema

scope.owned_layer: Task-row failure-streak projection, threshold quarantine, governed lifecycle resets, completion cleanup of per-provider runtime evidence, and queue/worker retry holds that survive the normal poll loop while a task is quarantined.
scope.not_changing: Provider classification, retry budgets, dispatch priority, review authority, or live runtime configuration.

review_remediation.required_change: A queue-backed retry held by task quarantine must survive the normal poll/assignment loop: it must not be superseded or complete its queue record merely because quarantined tasks are not normally assigned. The held parent must not be stale-failure reclassified, and governed reopen must release it for exactly one launch. Preserve the existing rotation/retry fence and exact-head Contents API GET regression.
review_remediation.evidence_requirement: This manifest is committed in PR #4533 before independent re-review and must be bound with REVIEW_FILE during exact-head approval.

acceptance.failure_projection: Repeated distinct worker failures increment the task-row failure_streak.
acceptance.quarantine: The configured failure-loop threshold changes the task status to quarantined and normal dispatch ignores it until governed reopen.
acceptance.success_reset: Worker completion resets the task-row failure_streak and clears detailed records for every provider on that task.
acceptance.cross_provider_reset: A later failure from a provider that had a pre-completion record starts at one and leaves the task in_progress.
acceptance.retry_quarantine: A threshold-crossing rotation transitions the worker retry to retry_quarantined without scheduling it; due queue and worker retries are held while the task row is quarantined and do not launch a worker. A queue-backed held worker remains durable through the normal poll/assignment loop instead of being superseded.
acceptance.reopen_release: The governed reopen command resets failure_streak to zero, after which one held queue-backed worker retry becomes eligible and launches exactly once.

commands.result: True; GitHub Contents API verified the committed manifest at rejected PR #4533 head b5509721342745174d25ce10134be342b80c50c1 using the explicit GET query.

commands.command: python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py scripts/ai_status.py scripts/test_ai_status.py && git diff --check

review.approval_protocol: Review this committed manifest and the exact PR head, then approve with REVIEW_FILE=docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-TASK-FAILURE-STREAK-SCHEMA-20260804/evidence.json.
review.prior_review: The canonical review bridge first rejected completion reset coverage and then the manifest lookup; the existing exact-head manifest regression now passes. Codex2 rejected 0d9b4ce633233bc2c426b58986deadd9c24af60d because quarantine still allowed rotation and due retry_backoff paths to dispatch, then rejected 9b44725423ccab64a1ae2a051405279344e718f6 because poll_workers superseded a queue-backed held retry before reopen. This manifest is the reviewed artifact for the complete retry-hold remediation.
